channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the House
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/23/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: HB 1276 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Plesa
item.description: Relating to disclosures and other requirements concerning virtual currency kiosk transactions; authorizing a fee.

item.title: HB 1277 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Canales
item.description: Relating to compliance with the public information law, including operation of a hotline to provide information about open records requirements.

item.title: HB 1278 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Schoolcraft
item.description: Relating to the promotion of a public school student from the third grade to the fourth grade, including reading proficiency requirements and accelerated instruction for certain students.

item.title: HB 1279 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Pierson
item.description: Relating to the duties of the Texas Maternal Mortality and Morbidity Review Committee and the collection, maintenance, and disclosure of maternal health records regarding voluntary termination of pregnancy.

item.title: HB 1280 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Gervin-Hawkins
item.description: Relating to a grant program for municipal pedestrian infrastructure administered by the Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs.

item.title: HB 1281 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Gervin-Hawkins
item.description: Relating to a grant program for neighborhood organization pedestrian infrastructure administered by the Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs.
